Championship|2017 Argentina]]|}} {{MedalBronze|[[2013 FIBA Americas Championship|2013 Venezuela]]|}} }} '''Nicolás''' "'''Nico'''" '''Laprovíttola''' (born January 31, 1990) is an Argentine professional [[basketball]] player for [[Joventut Badalona]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]] and the [[Basketball Champions League|FIBA Champions League]]. He is also a member of the [[Argentina national basketball team]]. ==Professional career== ===Club Atlético Lanús (2007–2013)=== Laprovíttola's beginnings in basketball first started with [[Club Deportivo Morón|Deportivo Morón]], and then at [[Club Atlético Lanús|Lanús]], when he was 17 years old. In 2007, he made his pro debut with Lanús when the team played in the [[Torneo Nacional de Ascenso|Argentine 2nd Division]]. They achieved [[promotion and relegation|promotion]] that season to the top [[Liga Nacional de Básquet|Argentine League]]. Laprovíttola led his team to the Argentine League Final Series in the 2012–13 season against [[Regatas Corrientes]]. But the experience of the opposing team, led by [[Paolo Quinteros]], [[Federico Kammerichs]], and [[Jerome Meyinsse]], was crucial during the series, and the team of Corrientes won the national title. Laprovíttola played for six seasons with Club Atlético Lanús. ===Flamengo (2013–2015)=== During his preparation for the [[2013 FIBA Americas Championship]], Laprovíttola spoke about how excited he was that he was going to be playing with [[Flamengo Basket|Flamengo]], to whom he gave several compliments.{{cite Spanish team. ===FC Barcelona (2021–2026)=== Laprovíttola would later join Madrid's rivals [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] as a [[free agent]], signing a 2-season contract in July 2021.{{cite web | url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/basketball/first-team/news/2199872/nico-laprovittola-talented-point-guard | website=FC Barcelona |access-date=26 November 2024 |language=en | title=Nico Laprovittola, talented point guard | date=July 28, 2021 }} The contract would later be extended to 2026.{{cite web | url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/basketball/first-team/news/2678327/nico-laprovittola-staying-to-2026 | website=FC Barcelona |access-date=26 November 2024 |language=en | title=Nico Laprovittola staying to 2026 | date=July 16, 2022 }} In the 2022–23 season, he would help the Catalans win the [[2023 ACB Playoffs#Finals|2023 ACB finals]]. On April 4, 2024, Laprovíttola hit the game-winning 3-pointer as Barcelona defeated Maccabi Tel Aviv 92 – 89 to secure a spot in the [[2024 EuroLeague Playoffs]].{{cite web | url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/euroleague/1654332/laprovittola-gets-barca-to-playoffs-sends-maccabi-to-play-in/amp | title=Laprovittola gets Barca to playoffs, sends Maccabi to Play-In | date=April 4, 2024 }} In October 2024, he was helped off the court by his teammates after hurting his knee during a [[Liga ACB]] game against [[Baskonia]]. Immediate tests showed a knee ligament sprain. He would have to undergo surgery later that month after having torn his cruciate ligaments, which put an end to his 2024–25 season.{{cite web |title=Nico Laprovittola operation a success|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/basketball/first-team/news/4158765/nico-laprovittola-operation-a-success |website=FC Barcelona |access-date=26 November 2024 |language=en |date=30 October 2024}} After making his return at the beginning of the 2025–26 season, Laprovíttola suffered another major injury while training in March 2026. He suffered an abductor [[tendon rupture]] on his right thigh, which would sideline him for three months.{{cite web |first=Geoff |last=Gillingham |title=Nico Laprovittola out for three months with adductor injury |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/nico-laprovittola-out-for-three-months-with-adductor-injury/ |website=[[EuroLeague]] |access-date=12 March 2026 |language=en |date=12 March 2026}} ===Return to Joventut Badalona (2026–present)=== On July 15, 2026, Laprovíttola signed a three–year deal with [[Joventut Badalona]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.penya.com/es/inicio/noticias/288-2026-2027/5471-un-regreso-historico-el-genio-de-moron-se-reencuentra-con-el-asisa-joventut|title=Un regreso histórico: el genio de Morón se reencuentra con el ASISA Joventut|date=July 15, 2026|website=penya.com|access-date=July 15, 2026|language=es}} ==National team career== Laprovíttola played with the junior national team of Argentina at the 2008 FIBA Americas Under-18 Championship in [[Taiwan]], where he won a gold medal and qualified for the [[2009 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]] in New Zealand. Argentina finished in fifth place at the Under-19 World Championship. He also played at the [[Basketball at the 2011 Pan American Games – Men's tournament|2011 Pan American Games]]. In 2012, Laprovíttola played with the senior men's [[Argentine national basketball team]] at the [[South American Basketball Championship 2012|2012 South American Championship]], in [[Resistencia, Chaco|Resistencia]], where he won the gold medal. After the 2012–13 season, Laprovíttola was selected for the Argentine national team at the [[FIBA Stanković Cup]] tournament in China.{{cite web|url=http://globoesporte.globo.com/basquete/noticia/2013/07/reforco-do-flamengo-laprovittola-e-cestinha-em-duelo-da-copa-stankovic.html|title=Reforço do Flamengo, Laprovittola é cestinha em duelo da Copa Stankovic|work=GloboEsporte.com|date=July 5, 2013|access-date=July 30, 2013|language=pt}} He was also selected by coach [[Julio Lamas]] to represent Argentina at the [[2013 FIBA Americas Championship]], where he won the bronze medal, the [[South American Basketball Championship 2014|2014 South American Championship]], where he won the silver medal and the [[2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup]]. Laprovíttola also played at the [[Basketball at the 2015 Pan American Games – Men's tournament|2015 Pan American Games]], at the [[2015 FIBA Americas Championship]], where he won the silver medal, and at the [[Basketball at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2016 Summer Olympics]]. In 2019, he participated in the team that won the [[Basketball at the 2019 Pan American Games – Men's tournament|Pan American gold medal in Lima]]. He also competed in the [[Basketball at the 2020 Summer Olympics - Men's tournament|2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics]], held during 2021 because of the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], and his highlights included scoring 27 points in Argentina's preliminary round loss to Spain.{{Cite web|url=https://abcnews.go.com/Sports/wireStory/spain-beats-argentina-ties-doncics-slovenia-atop-group-79141369|title = Spain beats Argentina, ties Doncic's Slovenia atop Group C| website=[[ABC News (United States)|ABC News]] }} In 2022, Laprovittola won the gold medal in the [[2022 FIBA AmeriCup]] held in [[Recife]], Brazil.
